summary: Wyoming County lookout that the register says the Civilian Conservation Corps built; the register says state operation ended in 1991, and a 2017 visit found it in very bad condition.

events.note: Register: operated by the West Virginia Division of Forestry until closed in 1991. The state encyclopedia gives 1990 for the closure of the state's towers.
Visit report of August 30, 2017: very bad condition, vandal damage, gate not locked

notes_for_editor: Thin record. No build year found: the register says the CCC built the 86-foot tower but gives no date, and two WebSearch queries found no construction history. Closure date conflicts: the register says 1991 for this tower, while the e-WV entry says the state's towers closed in 1990; the story reports both. The WV Division of Forestry district list (wvenc-f5.wvnet.edu PDF) could not be fetched (DNS error), so it was not used. The Eastern US Lookouts page has only a header (Wyoming County; WV Division of Forestry). The 2017 visit form also marks the tower not staffed, but the story does not use it. Pocahontas Land Corporation's role is not explained by any source read. Current access, staffing and condition are unknown; the story says so and advises against climbing. No new photos added. Height 26.2 m is converted from the register's 86 ft.
